title: Automations
leadBefore: Switch on and it runs. Messages to customers still follow your permissions on the
forbiddenTitle: Only owners and managers can manage automations
forbiddenBody: Ask an owner or manager to switch automations on or off.
emptyAll: No automation fits your business yet.
runNowStarted: Started. The result shows in the run list in a moment.
googleUnavailable: Waiting for NIVO to switch on the Google integration
googleAccountHint: The account this automation writes the spreadsheet with. Changing it starts a new spreadsheet in that account.
messageHelp: The wording below is what NIVO uses. Check it, change it if you like, then save.
enableWithBody: Switch on and use this message
needsMessage: Check the message below, then press “Switch on and use this message”.
proposalNote: NIVO wrote this from your shop's information. Check it before you use it.
fallbackNote: NIVO could not write a custom one right now, so this is the standard wording.
variablesTitle: Blanks NIVO fills in for you
previewTitle: How it looks to a customer
staleTitle: This may need updating to your new shop information
staleBody: Your shop information changed after this message was approved.
gateAuto: The message is sent by itself.
gateAsk: The message waits for you to approve it before it is sent.
gateNever: This permission is off on the Authority page.
modeAi: NIVO writes each message for each customer, inside the wording you approved.
modeFixed: Fills in the name, the amount and so on. No AI.
trustOffer: You approved {n} messages in a row without changes. Let it send by itself?
autoSendOn: Sends by itself: you allowed it.
moduleHelp: Jobs that run by themselves for this agent. Switch each one on or off.
moduleEmpty: No automation fits this agent yet.
missingChannelCustomerChat: a customer chat channel (website, Telegram or Zalo)
missingCapabilityHasOpeningHours: opening hours in the shop information
patternDue: hạn thanh toán|thanh toán sau|công nợ|trả chậm|payment terms|net ?\d+|\d+ ngày.{0,20}thanh toán|thanh toán.{0,20}\d+ ngày
patternHoursline: giờ (làm việc|mở cửa)|mở cửa|opening hours|business hours
auditStreak: {count} approvals in a row without edits.
auditAutosendgranted: The owner allowed "{name}" to send by itself
auditAutosenddeclined: The owner did not allow "{name}" to send by itself yet
faultAutomationsRequirementMissing: It cannot be switched on yet: a requirement of this template is missing.
faultAutomationsNoMessage: This template sends no message to a customer, so it has no wording.
faultAutomationsBodyUnknownVariable: The wording uses a blank this template does not offer.
faultAutomationsGoogleNotUsed: This automation does not use Google.
faultAutomationsGoogleAccountUnknown: This Google account was not found.
faultAutomationsTrustNotOffered: Sending by itself has not been offered yet.
faultAutomationsRunNowUnavailable: This template cannot be run on demand.
faultAutomationsNotSaved: This automation could not be saved.
faultRefused: Only the owner and managers can change the automations.
